headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped rally to end lower amid profit booking and IT sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Profit booking emerged following a short mid-week recovery, dragging indices down.
Heavy selling pressure in IT stocks dragged benchmark indices lower.
Brent crude oil prices topping $97 per barrel weighed on market sentiment.
Uncertainty around interest rate hikes and lingering global risk factors added to market pressure.
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled up to nearly 1,000 points while Nifty 50 slipped below key levels of 25,700.
The benchmark NIFTY50 and SENSEX ended their four-week winning streak.
TCS was among the top gainers for the week while Tata Steel lagged.
Metals outperformed relative to IT stocks during early trades in the previous session.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian stock markets snapped a two-day rally as the Sensex and Nifty ended sharply lower due to selling pressure in IT stocks and profit booking. Rising Brent crude prices topping $97 also weighed on investor confidence. The fall marked the end of a four-week winning streak for the benchmark indices.
